detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=gcp`.
• Install and configure Cloud provider TA database inputs with the modular input for `google:gcp:audit`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.12.1.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `protoPayload.methodName` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Configure required cloud inputs per provider guide; index=gcp sourcetype=google:gcp:audit.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=gcp sourcetype="google:gcp:audit" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=gcp sourcetype="google:gcp:audit"
| table _time protoPayload.methodName protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail resourceName
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.12.7_cloud_database_cloud_sql_7"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `google:gcp:audit` in `index=gcp` to detect cloud database cloud sql connection spike. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the GCP Logs Explorer console for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `protoPayload.methodName` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_12_7_alert` with severity aligned to `high` criticality. Dashboard: Dashboard panel, alert, and weekly compliance report..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Cloud provider TA database inputs and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
